description: For a total represented function with a zero at every parameter tuple, the specified least-zero graph strongly represents regular minimization in \(Q\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.regularSearch_stronglyRepresents {n : ℕ} (f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) → ℕ)
  (hdom : ∀ (x : Fin n → ℕ), ∃ k, f (Fin.snoc x k) = 0)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 1) ⊕ Unit))
  (hf : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents f φ) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.StronglyRepresents
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.regularSearch f hdom)
    (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.graphSearch φ)
